name: Pacific Ocean
fact: The Pacific Ocean is the biggest ocean — it's bigger than all the continents put together!

name: Atlantic Ocean
fact: The Atlantic Ocean separates the Americas from Europe and Africa.

name: Indian Ocean
fact: The Indian Ocean is the warmest ocean in the world.

name: Arctic Ocean
fact: The Arctic Ocean is the smallest and coldest ocean, and parts of it are covered in ice.

name: Southern Ocean
fact: The Southern Ocean surrounds Antarctica and is home to many penguins and whales.
